evidence_candidates.source_locator: system design, software innovation, and future plans sections
evidence_candidates.excerpt: RIKEN announced a FugakuNEXT design combining Fujitsu's MONAKA-X CPU and an NVIDIA GPU with software and application co-design. The plan targets operation around 2030 and describes a roughly 40 MW power constraint, while performance figures remain project targets.
evidence_candidates.statement_supported: RIKEN's August 2025 FugakuNEXT plan combines MONAKA-X and NVIDIA acceleration with software co-design and targets operation around 2030.
